notes.title: First Playtest Complete! Debrief in Progress
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544175/15c11d096bf3cebb0e4609563248c8b2c54b337f.png[/img]
The dust has settled, and the first playtest has officially wrapped up!
A massive [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who jumped in and battled hard; your participation means the world to us.

Right now, the team is diving deep into all the data, feedback, and in-game moments to analyze what worked, what didn’t, and what needs to level up. We’re already shaping the next phase based on what you helped us uncover.

Want to make an even bigger impact?
Take a few minutes to fill out [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdbfmgklxfSq2i1GX4lYT6A0_2WJyh4BMh5XMO1axGCGwVGPw/viewform][b]our post-playtest survey[/b][/url]. Be honest, be brutal—we’re here to build something incredible together.

Stay tuned! We’ll share the results soon and what’s coming next.
